info.name: Stage: Furniture Erase (LaMa)
info.description: Removes furniture using LaMa inpainting. Takes the matched adjusted+mask pair from the detect stage.

inputs.node_1: furniture-detect/adjusted_*.png — resized room photo from detect. NOT the original upload.
inputs.node_2: furniture-detect/mask_*.png — furniture mask from detect. Must match node_1 dimensions.

info.node_ids_for_orchestrator: node 1 = room image, node 2 = mask, node 4 = SaveImage output
info.why_lama: MiniMax failed with HalfTensor device mismatch on RTX 4060 8GB. LaMa is CNN-based, 190MB, no VRAM issues.
info.mask_polarity: RMBG outputs white=furniture. LamaRemoverIMG with invert_mask=false internally inverts the mask before processing, so white areas are erased. No InvertMask node needed.
info.input_names: images (IMAGE), masks (IMAGE) — both plural, both IMAGE type (not MASK). Verified from remover.py source.
